Opening the Tower's rolls…
Each ring of Somnucor elects its own council. The one with the most votes is the ring's Warden , and the Wardens together are the High Council .
A council brings motions and votes on them; a motion passes when more than half of its seats say yes, and then it really happens.
The councils are for dreamers aged 13 and over.
Voting and standing are for dreamers whose dues are paid. Everyone can read who sits and what they decide.
👑 Keeper: you set the limits and stay above the vote. You can veto any open motion here; every other control is on the Keeper page, under In the game, Councils.
